title: Herbalism
source_markdown:
# Herbalism

## Purpose

Collect herbs and botanical reagents for alchemy and other crafts.

## Track

- Track: **Gathering**
- Owning building: **Gathering Camp**
- Hero rule: one Gathering profession per hero
- Change rule: learning another Gathering profession replaces only the Gathering choice

## Progression

Herbalism has authored levels 1–5 in `data/base/profession-buildings/progression.json`. Its effective level mirrors the owning Gathering Camp level.

Assignment timing and drag/drop training are supplied by the shared building-assignment framework in WOWUI-079.
